## Factorial 稳定性问题 (2026-05-18)

   - `kill 416289`

   - `nvidia-smi` 确认 GPU 2,3 已释放

   - `ps aux | grep 576727 | grep -v grep` 确认 PID 存活
   - `nvidia-smi` 确认 GPU 0,1 仍被占用

